profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Rivian
profile.summary:
Hi there! I'm James.

As a full-stack software engineer focused on designing and implementing business-critical software applications, I have successfully delivered innovative solutions and improved the user experience. I have a strong background in Typescript (Javascript) and cloud technologies, and have used these skills to design and implement highly scalable microservices, optimize GraphQL APIs, and create Gitlab CI/CD pipelines. I have also had the opportunity to collaborate on developing ticketing systems that improved the vehicle service experience for Rivian owners, and to enhance the identity & authentication experience for millions of Ticketmaster customers. As a passionate problem solver with love for learning and continuous improvement, I am excited to bring my skills and experience to new challenges and make a positive impact through my work.

Certifications
Oracle - OCA Java SE 8 Programmer
Neo4j - Certified Professional

Email: april9288@gmail.com

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented ticketing systems that improved the vehicle service experience for Rivian owners.

• Built ticket search applications on Elasticsearch, dramatically improving latency by 90% from over 12 seconds to under 2 seconds.

• Built modular microservices with GraphQL running on Kubernetes and AWS Lambda, supporting rapid feature rollout and horizontal scaling.

• Created event‑driven pipelines using Kinesis and DynamoDB Streams, ensuring reliable ingestion and processing of service events.

• Engineered GitLab CI/CD pipelines and reusable Lambda layers for common dependencies, accelerating build and deployment times.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Enhanced the identity & authentication experience for millions of Ticketmaster customers

• Built a pluggable and secure Multi-factor Authentication (MFA) web app

• Built a scalable Sign-up / Log-in web app, loading on ticketmaster.com

• Built reusable UI components

• Contributed unit tests to multiple codebases, increasing code coverage to above 90%

• Supported internal MFA consumers by supplying documentation
positions.insights: Skills: REST APIs · JavaScript · Node.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Jest · Java · React.js

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
• Performed SQL queries to generate daily KPI reports

• Built a web crawler to aggregate data and generate reports using Javascript and Python Selenium

• Built a Slack bot to deliver reports using Python SMTP library, Twilio SMS library, and Heroku

• Increased the customer satisfaction rate on BBB.org to "A" by providing an actionable decision tree derived from a linear regression model of customer data
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Python (Programming Language) · JavaScript · Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) · R (Programming Language)

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
• Awarded grand prize in a startup idea competition with a diffuser controller

• Built a diffuser controller software running on Arduino that controls the lid, fan, and sleeping light

• Built a mobile app, connecting with the device via Bluetooth, allowing users to control it remotely and set up alarms for desired times

positions.title: Sergeant - Logistics System Operation
positions.description:
• Supported supply chain management by operating a warehouse management system

• Analyzed inventory data and generated daily reports using VBA scripts

• Trained associates on using the warehouse management system and VBA

publications.title: How I got a 100% Lighthouse score with my React app
